state.title: State (2-letter)
state.description: Keep only incidents in this state, e.g. LA. Leave blank for every state.

dateFrom.title: From date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Keep only incidents on or after this date. The year part also picks which annual file to pull.

dateTo.title: To date (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Keep only incidents on or before this date. Blank means no upper bound.

materialKeyword.title: Material keyword
materialKeyword.description: Keep only incidents whose text contains this word, e.g. crude or diesel.

maxItems.title: Max incidents
maxItems.description: Stop after this many incidents. Hard ceiling is 1000, so a run cannot run away.

timeoutSeconds.title: Run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Stop collecting after this many seconds so a run cannot hang.
